verdict.rationale: Docs show ChatGPT can search the web, browse multiple sources, compare them, and produce cited results in-chat (docs-86, docs-90), and can turn research into finished documents/reports (docs-66, docs-68, docs-60). However, there is no explicit mention of a dedicated 'Deep Research' autonomous multi-source research mode/run with a structured long-form cited report as its own distinct feature — the evidence only shows general web-search-with-citations and document drafting capabilities. missing for 10: an explicitly named deep-research mode, evidence of autonomous long-running multi-source research runs, and a structured final cited-report output format.
